meta_title: A Woman's Touch | Painter & Decorator Leeds
meta_description: A Woman's Touch is a professional painter and decorator in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating services. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From a fresh coat of paint to complete room transformations, we bring colour and care to every project in Leeds and surrounding areas.
services_subhead: Whether it's interior redecorating, exterior painting, or specialist finishes, we handle every project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete room makeovers including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and trim. We protect your furniture and clean up thoroughly — your home is ready to enjoy the same day.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Refresh your home's exterior with weatherproof exterior paint and rendered walls. We use quality products built to last and withstand Yorkshire weather.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging on feature walls, full rooms, or entire homes. We handle awkward corners, stairs, and archways with precision.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architrave, and fitted furniture painted to a high standard. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a professional finish.

services.title: Textured & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian finishes, and bespoke decorative effects. Add depth and character to any room with our specialist techniques.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Thorough surface preparation including filling, sanding, and undercoating. A solid foundation ensures a flawless, long-lasting finish.

about_pullquote: I started this business to prove that decorating done right transforms not just walls, but how you feel about your home.
about_para_1: A Woman's Touch was founded in 2012 by a single mum determined to bring professional, reliable decorating to Leeds without the typical builder price tag or attitude. Over 13 years, we've grown from one painter to a small, trusted team known for showing up on time, protecting your home, and delivering results that speak for themselves. Every job is treated as if it's our own home.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honest communication, transparent pricing, and genuine care for detail. We don't cut corners with cheap materials or skip preparation — your paint job will last years, not months. Our customers come back because they know exactly what they're getting: professional work, a clean site, and someone who listens to what they really want.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the sitting room completely redecorated — new wallpaper, woodwork painted, ceiling done. The team were tidy, professional, and finished on time. My home looks brilliant. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on exterior painting and got a callback within 24 hours. Price was fair, work was excellent. They protected everything and left the front of my house spotless. Will use again for the kitchen next.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Fantastic wallpaper work on my feature wall. They handled the tricky bits around the window perfectly. Very professional team, arrived when they said they would. Really happy with the result.
reviews.author: Helen C.
